answer: An agent marketplace makes escrow the inlet to paid work: each identity must lock $100 for 30 days to receive one bidding slot. An attacker can let bots wander across thousands of names, but every active name ties up another $100. Creating 1,000 eligible identities therefore immobilizes $100,000 for a month, imposing financing costs even if every deposit is returned. The promise of unlimited influence from free accounts becomes a fable.
